# Getting help

Start with the [installation guide](../docs/INSTALLATION.md) and [user guide](../docs/USER_GUIDE.md). Hover names and controls in the app for short explanations.

- **Questions and ideas:** [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/slimedragonair/SlimeyBeats-EZ-Master/discussions).
- **Reproducible problems:** [open a bug report](https://github.com/slimedragonair/SlimeyBeats-EZ-Master/issues/new/choose), including version, steps and what happened.
- **Security vulnerabilities:** [report privately](https://github.com/slimedragonair/SlimeyBeats-EZ-Master/security/advisories/new).

Before sharing reports or screenshots, remove private paths and personal information. Use a short synthetic or clearly licensed audio example. Describe subjective sound preferences separately from reproducible signal or export errors.

WAV mastering works without extra codecs. Compressed inputs, FLAC/MP3 exports and resampling require a separate FFmpeg/ffprobe installation. The current release is for Windows x64; web and mobile versions are future work.
